{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Confirm there are zero such rows
assert len(qa_rows) == 0, f'Expected 0 QA rows, found {len(qa_rows)}'

# Now count completed orders
completed_count = sales['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Print the result
completed_count"}
